name: Runway
knownFor: A dedicated AI video studio, with Gen-series models and a public individual price ladder.
popCaption: Editorial estimate · checked Nov 2026. Runway is one of the longest-running dedicated AI video products; no public visit-share table was found this session.
pro: Clear official prices and a long-standing product
con: Popularity is editorial; credit packs can add to the monthly seat
costCaption: Official runwayml.com/pricing (checked Nov 2026): Standard $15/month or $12/month billed annually; Pro $35/month or $28/month billed annually (labeled popular); Max $95/month or $76/month billed annually. A free plan with one-time credits is also listed. Rated on Standard, the cheapest ongoing individual plan.

name: Google Veo
knownFor: Google’s video models, offered through Gemini, Google Flow, and related Google AI plans.
popCaption: Editorial estimate, with distribution through Gemini and Google AI plans (Gemini had 24.2% of seven-assistant website visits in October 2026, Similarweb — that is not a Veo-specific figure) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Distribution through Gemini and Flow, with published credit amounts
con: Not a standalone video brand; limits depend on the Google plan and credits
costCaption: Veo / Flow access is sold through Google AI plans. Official one.google.com/about/google-ai-plans (checked Nov 2026) lists Google AI Plus $4.99/month (200 Flow credits), Google AI Pro $19.99/month (1,000 Flow credits), and Ultra at $99.99 or $199.99/month with much higher credits. Rated on Google AI Pro, a typical individual paid plan for serious video use. Usage is credit-based inside the plan.

name: Sora
knownFor: OpenAI’s video generator, offered through ChatGPT and related OpenAI products.
popCaption: Editorial estimate, with distribution through ChatGPT (55.7% of seven-assistant website visits in October 2026, Similarweb — that is not a Sora-specific figure) · checked Nov 2026
pro: Built into the most-visited assistant website in the Similarweb set
con: Access and limits vary by plan; this is not a dedicated video editor
costCaption: Sora access is tied to ChatGPT paid plans. Rated on ChatGPT Plus at $20/month (OpenAI Help, checked Nov 2026). Higher Pro tiers ($100–$500/month) advertise more image and video capacity. Confirm current Sora eligibility on chatgpt.com/pricing, because access can differ by plan and region.

costCaption: Kling sells credit- or membership-based plans on official Kling sites. This session did not capture a current official individual monthly figure. Editorial estimate $$ for a typical individual plan. Confirm current prices on the official Kling site you use (region-specific domains).
